_doc: Canonical option-group vocabulary for species creation choices. Keyed on the group's DISPLAYED name (`display_name` when present, else `name` — the same expression the app uses at player/app.jsx `fcSpeciesOwedLabel`; 32 of 208 groups carry no display_name). `noun` is the singular head noun the held-commit CTA speaks: count 1 renders "Pick one <noun> to continue". Lowercase — the CTA's text-transform paints the capitals. The app NEVER singularizes a label by string; the noun comes from here. Ruled R-B409D-1/2 (b409-data-half-recon); B-409.

_meta.noun: The singular head noun for the held-commit CTA (R-B409D-2). Four entries add a head noun to the book's heading because the heading is not itself a countable noun: Technology -> technology level, Breathing -> breathing type, Vocal Cords -> vocal-cord type, Variable Forms -> form.
_meta.spelling: `Vocal Cords` is the SOURCE's spelling, read at the CSG page (Polis Massan.docx: 'Cords' x3, 'Chords' x0). The registry previously carried 'Vocal Chords'; corrected at the import path under R-B409D-3.
